title: Tensoring an extension by zero
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow Y$ be an
open immersion, and use
the finite coefficient ring
$A$. For $K\in D(U,A)$ and $M\in D(Y,A)$, there is a natural
isomorphism

$$
(j_!K)\otimes_A^LM\simeq j_!(K\otimes_A^Lj^*M),
$$

where $j_!$ is extension by
zero, tensor is the derived
tensor product, and $j^*$ is the
derived pullback.

proof.text: Use the inverse of the already proved fixed-scalar pro-etale derived projection isomorphism lem-cbc-extension-zero-projection-formula, at ModuleCat(ULift A). A finite commutative ring is Noetherian, so the published flat-pullback instance applies. Its derived inverse image is canonically isomorphic to termwise upperStar, and the published upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction identifies the latter with termwise open restriction. This realizes the underived projection, total-complex construction and derived descent of the blueprint without reproving them.

Let E_U and E_Y be the canonical fixed-scalar/intrinsic module equivalences from def-weil-extension-by-zero. Their unit isomorphisms, associators and unitors identify j_! followed by E_Y inverse with E_U inverse followed by fixed-scalar extension; restriction followed by E_U inverse with E_Y inverse followed by fixed-scalar restriction; and E_U followed by intrinsic extension with fixed-scalar extension followed by E_Y. Derive these three natural isomorphisms using mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. Whisker the fixed-scalar derived projection isomorphism with E_U inverse and E_Y inverse in the two input variables, then postcompose with E_Y. Compose with the three comparisons just constructed. The resulting isomorphism has precisely sfOpenTensorLeft and sfOpenTensorRight as endpoints. All factors are natural isomorphisms of bifunctors, so simultaneous derived naturality is retained.
